name: TFMG Engines and Power
description: TFMG makes rotation from fuel with engines, and electricity with its own circuit system.

pages.title: TFMG Engines and Power
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Engines burn fuel for ordinary rotation
- **Regular Engine**: parts, then Engine Cylinders that match the fuel
- Regular and Large Engines: pump the CO2 out to an Exhaust or they stop
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() TFMG circuits are separate from FE, but its connectors can import and export FE
TFMG makes rotation from fuel with engines, and electricity with its own circuit system. Both plug into normal [#](7A3C9A)[Create networks](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#]().

pages.title: Regular Engine
pages.text: [#](7A3C9A)[Assembled](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]() from a body: click in its parts first (goggles name the next one), then matching Engine Cylinders. Click it with a Shaft to set the rotation output. Lubrication oil ([Oil Can](item://tfmg:oil_can) or bucket) and cooling fluid are optional; each cuts fuel use by 30%%.

The cylinder sets the fuel: Engine Cylinder burns gasoline, kerosene or naphtha, Diesel Engine Cylinder diesel, Autogas Engine Cylinder LPG, Simple Engine Cylinder creosote or furnace gas.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** burnt fuel fills an 8,000 mB CO2 tank. Pump it out to an Exhaust or the engine stops.

pages.title: Large Engine
pages.text: Burns less refined fuel (diesel, kerosene, naphtha, furnace gas). Needs air in and CO2 pumped out to an Exhaust. A Shaft goes on like a steam engine.

Radial and Turbine Engines are the other types. An Engine Controller linked to the engine sets speed and direction. Fuel comes from [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#](); engine rotation is ordinary rotation and obeys [#](2E5AAC)[Stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]().

pages.title: Generator
pages.text: The source of TFMG electricity. A source gives Voltage and Power; devices have Resistance, and current is voltage divided by resistance.

pages.title: Cable Hubs
pages.text: Wire hubs and insulators with copper, aluminum or constantan spools. A Voltmeter (Electric Gauge) shows what a part carries.

TFMG's cable connectors can import and export FE, so TFMG circuits can touch FE machines. Its wires are separate from Crafts & Additions wires. See [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation vs Electricity](entry://industry/power_compared)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Blocks share a **group**: members of one group split the voltage, the rest keep all of it. Change a block's group with the **Configuration Wrench**.\
\
A Diode, Potentiometer, Switch or Transformer starts a subnetwork.

pages.title: Large Transformer
pages.text: Built in place: two wound Large Coils side by side, then click one with a Laminated Magnetic Alloy Block, a Block of Steel and a Lubrication Oil bucket. Mining it returns both coils (turns kept) and the steel.
